description: This file contains a controller class 'Weight' for managing the shipping weight extension in the OpenCart admin panel. It handles displaying the configuration form and saving settings related to shipping weight, including loading models, language strings, and rendering views.

classes.name: Weight
classes.description: Controller class for handling the shipping weight configuration in OpenCart admin extension. It provides methods to display the configuration form ('index') and save settings ('save').

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the shipping weight configuration page, loads necessary data such as geo zones and tax classes, and renders the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the shipping weight configuration settings via POST request, with permission checking and JSON response.
